Recording_20261008_100211.m4a|47110|smal.text: Okay, starting from the car park. Ground is soaked from last night, the path by the first gate is basically a pond.

Recording_20261008_104105.m4a|42491|smal.text: Note to self the style after the second field has a broken step. Report it to the council rights of way team when I get home.
